text:
marta: seeing a latency spike in us-east serving runtime — p50 jumped from 30ms -> 240ms since 09:02 UTC. Affected route: /v1/generate, model: redwood-small-quant. Investigating.

kevin: is this across all hosts or single pool?

marta: looks concentrated on pool gpu-pool-13. p99 + request queue length high. Posting quick perf dump.

marta: ```
perf_snapshot:
host: gpu-13-1
kernel_choice: {attention: cuBLAS_fused_v2, matmul: auto}
avg_batch_size: 1.8
queue_len: 42
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.34
latencies_ms: p50: 240, p95: 640, p99: 1200
```

devon: kernel_choice shows fallback to slower matmul kernel for long seqs. Batch histogram skewed to tiny batches. Could be continuous batching logic thrashing.

raj: host CPU steal high, noisy neighbor suspected (container doing heavy host I/O). I also see NVLink saturation on gpu-13-1.

ops-oncall: throttling new sessions on pool gpu-pool-13 with `rctl pool set gpu-pool-13 max_concurrency=60`

marta: rolling a feature flag to force batch_size_min=4 for this pool to reduce tiny-batch overhead. `ff set runtime.batch_min gpu-pool-13 4`

incident-bot: Incident INVESTIGATING: Latency spike on /v1/generate — Sev2. Status: mitigations in progress. Pagerduty: #P12345

kevin: suggest routing heavy requests to redwood-small-quant-fast (lower-memory quant tweak) as fallback. Can we do route override?

marta: doing route override: `route set /v1/generate pool=gpu-pool-12 model=redwood-small-quant-fast if latency>200` — testing

devon: profiler after tag update — now kernel selection prefers optimized matmul_v3, avg_batch_size 6.6, kv_cache_miss_rate dropped to 0.08, p95 120ms.

devon: ```
post_mitigation_snapshot:
hosts_sampled: gpu-12-2,gpu-12-3
kernel_choice: {attention: cuBLAS_fused_v2, matmul: matmul_v3_opt}
avg_batch_size: 6.6
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.08
latencies_ms: p50: 28, p95: 120, p99: 240
```

raj: noisy neighbor confirmed, evicted offending container and repinned pods. NVLink saturation down.

ops-oncall: removing throttle 10m after stabilization `rctl pool reset gpu-pool-13 max_concurrency`

marta: thank you. I'll add follow-ups: tuning batching heuristic to penalize tiny batches, add kernel-selection guardrail when steal>10%, and add eviction automation for NVLink saturation.

kevin: can we capture flamegraphs from before/after for postmortem? Devon pls collect and attach.

devon: uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-incident-archives/P12345/ — flame_before.svg, flame_after.svg, perf_dump.json

incident-bot: Incident RESOLVED: mitigations restored normal latencies. Duration 42m. Playbook: /incidents/P12345/postmortem-draft

marta: will draft postmortem and assign action items. Thanks all. :heart:
